route.name: Todoist Alternatives With a One-Time Purchase
route.description: Personal task capture and project organization with paid native editions that can be bought once. Compare Things 3 platform purchases, OmniFocus 4 native perpetual licenses and the 2Do Mac direct-purchase license. Platforms, mobile purchases, optional Web subscriptions and future update entitlements differ. This is a bounded personal-workflow comparison; it does not guarantee team, platform or complete Todoist parity.
